purpose: Tagged PDFs whose tables are drawn without rules: wrapped, vertically centred cells (borderless-table), and the browser default style with cells a few pixels apart (default-table). Only the structure tree gives their rows and cells. table-beside-prose puts a small table among long paragraphs, so the table holds far less than half of its band.
authored: written for these tests in markitai-rust
